source_and_budget_policy: Only exact frozen bytes and original source state, profiles, record limits and budget dimensions. Match candidate and released readers on identical packets.
scope: Every verified registry under Cryptid plus retained Thoth and Egyptian-batch protection, original reproducible D% and BB, and the existing 832 public-contract replay.
per_cohort: Execute the two roles sequentially, retain raw results and stage hashes, and persist the complete group as a separate artifact.

comparison.semantic_scoring: Original keys and scorers. Record score changes, prior supported losses, unsupported claims and diagnostic changes separately.
comparison.release_policy: Prospective proposal only. Retained 17/100 and original unavailable development key stay retired; no new failed protected safety result can be silently accepted. Original exact 87/96 remains failed. Nine-case proposal activation requires separate explicit approval. Required exact-head software and deployed verification follow only after acceptance.
